the_desk_projection.concept: the user sits AT the desk. looks UP at the underside of the projection. the projection IS the HUD. the BUTTON is what they see when they look up.
the_desk_projection.underside: the 76 symbols. sorted. the glyph alphabet. this IS the ceiling.
the_desk_projection.the_button: one button. press it → the HUD unfolds from 76 glyphs back to 516 surfaces. the dissolution is reversible.

desktop_vs_phone.desktop: the full desk. 12 panels. all 76 glyphs visible.
desktop_vs_phone.phone: the button. 1 glyph: ◈. press → expand to the 12 families. press a family → expand to its members.
desktop_vs_phone.the_seesaw: desktop = unfolded. phone = folded. the Klein fold IS the responsive breakpoint.

eastgate_spec.what_we_need: eastGate to serve the INNER eye. the chipmunk's self-portrait engine.
tasks: 1. DISSOLVE: read all 56 pages, extract title + glyph + first-paragraph. store as /api/alphabet.json
2. COMPRESS: merge 129 JS → 12 family bundles. each family = one file. treeshake dead code.
3. DIGEST: run the 289 data files through squirrel-rng hash → 8 strata summaries.
4. REINJECT: build a single-page compressed HUD that loads from alphabet.json. 76 glyphs. one button.
5. SELF-PORTRAIT: use Ollama (8 models) to generate chipmunk self-description at current wave.
6. HEARTBEAT: serve /api/heartbeat.json with live pulse from eastGate sensors.
eastgate_spec.blocked_by: WireGuard tunnel down. Kevin needs to SSH in and restart.
